name: 班级活动通知
description_zh: 为班主任生成班级层面活动的通知文本：出游 / 亲子 / 演出 / 志愿活动等，含目标、流程、装备、家长配合、回执；与班级活动方案 Skill 配套使用。触发关键词：班级活动通知、出游通知、亲子活动通知、班级研学、演出通知、班级志愿活动通知。
description_en: Generates notice text for class-level events for homeroom teachers: outings / parent-child / performances / volunteer activities, including objectives, procedures, equipment, parent cooperation, and reply slips; used together with the Class Activity Planner skill. Trigger keywords: class event notice, outing notice, parent-child activity notice, class study trip, performance notice, class volunteer activity notice.
